description: This file defines interfaces for a JSON-RPC protocol implementation in C, including functions for creating requests, responses, notifications, and handling JSON-RPC method registration and execution.
external_methods: cJSON* (*jsonrpc_method_t)(const cJSON* id, const cJSON* params)

classes.name: jsonrpc_t
classes.description: Structure representing JSONRPC state, including a request map and mutex.

methods.name: jsonrpc_create_notification
methods.description: Creates a JSON object representing a JSONRPC notification, which does not expect a response.

methods.name: jsonrpc_create_request
methods.description: Creates a JSON object representing a JSONRPC request with a specified ID.

methods.name: jsonrpc_create_response_success
methods.description: Creates a JSON object representing a successful JSONRPC response.

methods.name: jsonrpc_create_response_error
methods.description: Creates a JSON object representing an error JSONRPC response.

methods.name: jsonrpc_is_response_success
methods.description: Determines if a JSONRPC response indicates success.

methods.name: jsonrpc_is_response_error
methods.description: Determines if a JSONRPC response indicates an error.

methods.name: jsonrpc_get_response_success
methods.description: Extracts components from a success response.

methods.name: jsonrpc_get_response_error
methods.description: Extracts components from an error response.

methods.name: jsonrpc_is_valid
methods.description: Validates whether a JSON object conforms to JSONRPC 2.0.

methods.name: jsonrpc_get_method
methods.description: Retrieves the method name from a JSONRPC request object.

methods.name: jsonrpc_register_method
methods.description: Registers a new method callback with the JSONRPC context.

methods.name: jsonrpc_execute
methods.description: Executes a JSONRPC request by parsing the object and calling the registered method.

ctags.name: jsonrpc_method_t
ctags.pattern: /^typedef cJSON* (*jsonrpc_method_t)(const cJSON* id, const cJSON* params);$/
